<?php
class RepeatedPendingThrowCache33 { function __destruct() { echo "A|"; } }
class RepeatedPendingThrowReturn33 { function __destruct() { echo "R|"; } }
function repeatedPendingThrowChild33() { echo "C|"; yield new RepeatedPendingThrowCache33(); echo "L|"; return new RepeatedPendingThrowReturn33(); }
function repeatedPendingThrowMiddle33() { try { echo "M|"; $reply = yield from $GLOBALS["child"]; echo "BAD-MIDDLE|"; } finally { echo "J|"; } }
function repeatedPendingThrowUpper33() { try { echo "U|"; yield from $GLOBALS["middle"]; echo "BAD-UPPER|"; } finally { echo "K|"; } }
function repeatedPendingThrowOuter33() { try { echo "O|"; yield from $GLOBALS["upper"]; echo "BAD-OUTER|"; } finally { echo "F|"; } }
$child = repeatedPendingThrowChild33(); $middle = repeatedPendingThrowMiddle33(); $upper = repeatedPendingThrowUpper33(); $outer = repeatedPendingThrowOuter33();
echo "P|"; $outer->rewind(); $child->next(); unset($child); echo "H|"; $first = new Exception("first33"); $second = new Exception("second33");
echo "T1|"; try { $upper->throw($first); echo "BAD-FIRST|"; } catch (Throwable $caughtFirst) { echo "C1|", $caughtFirst === $first ? 1 : 0, "|", $caughtFirst->getPrevious() === null ? 1 : 0, "|"; }
echo "G1|", $middle->valid() ? 1 : 0, "|", $upper->key() === null ? 1 : 0, "|";
echo "T2|"; try { $unused = $middle->throw($second); echo "BAD-SECOND|"; } catch (Throwable $caughtSecond) { echo "C2|", $caughtSecond === $second ? 1 : 0, "|", $caughtSecond->getPrevious() === null ? 1 : 0, "|"; }
$held = $upper->current(); echo "H2|", $held instanceof RepeatedPendingThrowCache33 ? 1 : 0, "|", $middle->valid() ? 1 : 0, "|";
unset($caughtFirst, $caughtSecond, $first, $second); echo "EX|"; unset($outer); echo "OUT|"; unset($upper); echo "UP|"; unset($middle); echo "MID|"; unset($held); echo "HELD-DROP|"; echo "E";

<?php
class RepeatedPendingThrowLate33 { function __destruct() { echo "R|"; } }
class RepeatedPendingThrowReplaceCache33 { function __destruct() { echo "D|"; throw new RuntimeException("replacement33"); } }
function repeatedPendingThrowDropRoots33($exception) { echo "DROP|"; unset($GLOBALS["outer"], $GLOBALS["upper"], $GLOBALS["middle"], $GLOBALS["child"]); echo "CLEARED|"; return $exception; }
function repeatedPendingThrowReplaceChild33() { echo "C|"; yield new RepeatedPendingThrowReplaceCache33(); echo "L|"; return [new RepeatedPendingThrowLate33()]; }
function repeatedPendingThrowReplaceMiddle33() { try { echo "M|"; $reply = yield from $GLOBALS["child"]; echo "BAD-MIDDLE|"; } finally { echo "J|"; } }
function repeatedPendingThrowReplaceUpper33() { try { echo "U|"; yield from $GLOBALS["middle"]; echo "BAD-UPPER|"; } finally { echo "K|"; } }
function repeatedPendingThrowReplaceOuter33() { try { echo "O|"; yield from $GLOBALS["upper"]; echo "BAD-OUTER|"; } finally { echo "F|"; } }
$child = repeatedPendingThrowReplaceChild33(); $middle = repeatedPendingThrowReplaceMiddle33(); $upper = repeatedPendingThrowReplaceUpper33(); $outer = repeatedPendingThrowReplaceOuter33();
echo "P|"; $outer->rewind(); $child->next(); echo "H|", $upper->current() instanceof RepeatedPendingThrowReplaceCache33 ? 1 : 0, "|"; unset($child); $first = new Exception("first33"); echo "T1|";
try { $upper->throw($first); echo "BAD-FIRST|"; } catch (Throwable $caughtFirst) { echo "C1|", $caughtFirst === $first ? 1 : 0, "|", $caughtFirst->getPrevious() === null ? 1 : 0, "|"; }
unset($caughtFirst, $first); $second = new Exception("second33"); echo "T2|";
try { $unused = $middle->throw(repeatedPendingThrowDropRoots33($second)); echo "BAD-SECOND|"; } catch (Throwable $caughtSecond) { echo "CALLER|", $caughtSecond instanceof RuntimeException ? 1 : 0, "|", $caughtSecond->getPrevious() === $second ? 1 : 0, "|"; }
unset($caughtSecond, $second); echo "E";
